text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey...! Hey...!
Hurry up and pass it over here...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, a cutthroat battle right under the rim...!!
This heat is freaking awesome...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—All right! A sweet pass right to the chest!!
Time for me to finish with a gorgeous dunk shooot—!!

Heading to the gym, I heard those voices coming
from inside and peeked in to look—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Hell yeah!! That's two points!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Come on, smiles all around, people!!
The whole team fought together for this win, didn't we?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um... I do not even know where to begin
pointing out what is wrong here, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What on earth are all those pantomimes
you have been doing by yourself just now, desu wa...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
What's the matter with you, you don't know?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I am the one who represented the world in Air Basketball
and dominated the final game with a spectacular dunk—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The great "Gold Jordan"!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm the only person in the entire world,
even without a ball, it still works—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: THAT is the great Gold Jordan's Air Basketball...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... I cannot say I understand in the slightest,
but it sounds like a formidable sport, desu wa...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...More importantly, your race is coming up soon.
Should you not be doing proper training?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You just don't get it, McQueen!
Basketball connects to everything, and everything connects to basketball.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Meaning if you play Air Basketball, you'll naturally
build the ultimate body to crush races!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Behold the great Gold Jordan's
Perfect Body Building!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Wait a sec? Something feels gross about this.
This name... the ring to it—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wait, are you kidding me...!
It's got 'Jordan' right in the name!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Calling myself 'Jordan' makes me sound
like that one certain gal—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You've gotta be JOKING...!!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Eh... What?
...Did someone just call my name?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, well, that is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me... I cannot make sense of it either,
but you likely do not need to pay it any mind, desu wa—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, my glorious name was supposed
to be Lord Gold Ship, wasn't it?!!

text_block_list.name: ゴールドシップ
text_block_list.text:
なにトチ狂ってんだ！！
しっかりしろよ、アタシぃぃーーッッ！！

text_block_list.name: ゴールドシップ
text_block_list.text: …………はぁ、飽きた。

text_block_list.name: ゴールドシップ
text_block_list.text:
なんかわかんねーけどいい汗かいたし、
そろそろゴルゴル星に戻るか。ばいならー。

……何が起こったのかわからないまま、
ゴールドシップは去っていった。
